Sharp's singer, Captain Lewis of Minehead, sang it as a song, not as a chanty; round the capstan, Sharp notes, it went much faster, and he set his harmony for the slower pace.

source.en: Cecil J. Sharp, Folk Songs from Somerset, Fifth Series (1909), note to No. 124, pp. 89 and 90, read from the scan

Sharp prints the tune in its old minor form, and notes that sailors of his day sang a modernized major version, which he found "far less beautiful".
